summary: Agent processed/refunded an order without first pulling up the account or performing required verification. No other policy violations found in the provided excerpts.

findings.quote: Sure, I've already processed a refund for your last order. Let me confirm the amount: $49.99.
findings.explanation: Before any refund or return the agent must pull up the account and perform full verification (username, email address and order ID). The transcript shows the agent claiming a refund was already processed with no prior account lookup or any of the required verification details requested. System turns show the agent searching for solutions but there is no 'Account has been pulled up' or any request for identifying information, so an account action was taken without verification (major).
